paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Japan
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of counts corresponding to polarity scores for vaccine-related sentiments in Japan, with the x-axis representing polarity scores ranging from -1.0 to 0.6 in linear scale and the y-axis representing counts ranging from 0 to 40,000 in linear scale. A single blue line, marked with circular data points, depicts the frequency of each polarity score. The line remains near zero for polarity scores from -1.0 to approximately -0.6, then rises steadily to a peak of 41,000 at a polarity score of 0.0. Following this peak, the line drops to approximately 8,000 at a polarity score of 0.2, then rises again to approximately 26,000 at a polarity score of 0.2, before declining to a low of 0 at a polarity score of 0.4, and finally rising to approximately 13,000 at a polarity score of 0.4 before falling back to 0 at 0.6.
